# Serverless runtime fixtures

These fixtures define the parser boundary for Serverless runtime declarations in [epic #86](https://github.com/arminazimi/evergreen/issues/86). The scope is `Runtime` on AWS SAM and CloudFormation functions and `Globals`, `provider.runtime` and per-function `runtime` in `serverless.yml`, and Terraform `runtime` on `aws_lambda_function` plus function app stacks (`azurerm_linux_function_app` and `azurerm_windows_function_app` `application_stack`, and the `runtime` of `google_cloudfunctions_function` and `google_cloudfunctions2_function`). Line numbers below are 1-based and count comments and blank lines.

The identifiers are parser examples. A lifecycle finding needs a reviewed rule with an authoritative source ([AWS Lambda runtimes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html), [Azure Functions language support](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-functions/language-support-policy), [Google Cloud Functions runtime support](https://cloud.google.com/functions/docs/runtime-support)). Positive files use retired identifiers from those schedules so a later rule can match them. This task does not add those rules. Zero files use identifiers those schedules still list as supported on 2026-10-21.

A parser returns each literal declaration and nothing else. Quotes around a value are not part of the value. A function that omits its own runtime is not a second declaration. Dynamic, commented, and lookalike values return nothing, not an error. A file with a syntax error returns nothing, including from lines that appear before the error.

| Fixture file | Expected case |
| --- | --- |
| `positive/template.yaml` | `Globals.Function.Runtime` `nodejs14.x` (line 7), `AWS::Serverless::Function` `Runtime` `python3.8` (line 15), and quoted `AWS::Lambda::Function` `Runtime` `dotnetcore3.1` (line 21). `Timeout`, `Handler`, `CodeUri`, and `Role` are not runtime declarations. |
| `positive/template.yml` | The `.yml` extension and a leading comment (line 1). Single-quoted `Globals.Function.Runtime` `nodejs16.x` (line 6) and `Runtime` `ruby2.7` (line 12). |
| `positive/serverless.yml` | `provider.runtime` `nodejs14.x` (line 4) and function `api` `runtime` `python3.8` (line 9). `memorySize` (line 5) is not a runtime. `worker` (line 11) sets no runtime, so it adds no declaration. |
| `positive/main.tf` | `aws_lambda_function.runtime` `nodejs14.x` (line 3), Linux function app `application_stack.node_version` `14` (line 13), Windows function app `application_stack.dotnet_version` `3.1` (line 23), `google_cloudfunctions_function.runtime` `nodejs14` (line 30), and `google_cloudfunctions2_function.build_config.runtime` `python38` (line 38). |
| `negative/template.yaml` | A comment (line 1), prose that mentions `Runtime` (line 2), a parameter default (line 6), `Timeout` (line 9), `OpenApiVersion` (line 12), `Runtime: !Ref` (line 10), `Runtime: !Sub` (line 18), an environment variable named `Runtime` (line 21), a `Ref` mapping (lines 25–26), a description string (line 28), and an image function with no `Runtime` (lines 32–33) produce no declarations. |
| `negative/serverless.yml` | A comment (line 1), `provider.runtime` set with `${opt:...}` (line 5), `memorySize` (line 6), `custom.runtime` (line 8), a function `runtime` set with `${self:...}` (line 12), a description string (line 13), an `image` function (line 15), and `runtime: latest` (line 18) produce no declarations. |
| `negative/main.tf` | A comment (line 1), an `aws_instance` (lines 3–6), `runtime = var.lambda_runtime` (line 10), a description string (line 13), an image function with no `runtime` (lines 16–21), `node_version = var.node_version` (line 28), legacy `azurerm_function_app` `linux_fx_version` (line 37), `runtime = local.function_runtime` (line 43), and a `data` source (lines 46–48) produce no declarations. |
| `zero/template.yaml` | `nodejs22.x` (line 6), `python3.13` (line 13), and `java21` (line 18): valid declarations, no lifecycle finding. |
| `zero/serverless.yml` | `provider.runtime` `nodejs22.x` (line 4) and function `runtime` `python3.13` (line 8): valid declarations, no lifecycle finding. |
| `zero/main.tf` | `aws_lambda_function.runtime` `nodejs22.x` (line 3), `node_version` `22` (line 13), and `build_config.runtime` `python313` (line 23): valid declarations, no lifecycle finding. |
| `malformed/template.yaml` | An unclosed flow sequence (line 8). The `Runtime` on line 4 is not returned. No error. |
| `malformed/serverless.yml` | An unclosed flow sequence (line 3). No partial declaration, no error. |
| `malformed/main.tf` | An unterminated string (line 2). No partial declaration, no error. |

These forms are not read: `template.json`, `serverless.yaml`, `serverless.ts`, `serverless.js`, and `*.tf.json`. Container-image functions (`PackageType: Image`, `image:`, `image_uri`) have no runtime declaration. CloudFormation intrinsics, parameter defaults, and Serverless Framework `${...}` values are dynamic even when a default sits inside the interpolation. Terraform `var`, `local`, and interpolations are dynamic. `linux_fx_version` on the legacy `azurerm_function_app` resource is not the `application_stack` form.
